claims: As of March 2026, Delcy Rodríguez is serving as acting president of Venezuela.
As of March 2026, Nicolás Maduro is deposed and currently in U.S. custody.
Nicolás Maduro's supporters consider him to be the de jure president.
On January 3, 2026, U.S. forces captured Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores in Caracas.
The capture of Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores occurred in a military operation named Operation Absolute Resolve.
Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores were transported to New York City.
Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores are facing charges of drug trafficking and "narco-terrorism".
Nicolás Maduro and Cilia Flores have pleaded not guilty.
Delcy Rodríguez was serving as vice president prior to Nicolás Maduro's capture.
Delcy Rodríguez was sworn in as acting president on January 5, 2026.
Delcy Rodríguez has initiated oil privatization.
Delcy Rodríguez has opened the oil sector to private investment.
Delcy Rodríguez has passed an amnesty law for political prisoners.
The United States has restarted diplomatic relations with the new Venezuelan government.
The United States has reopened the U.S. embassy in Caracas.
Nicolás Maduro had been in power since 2013.
A government-controlled council declared Nicolás Maduro the winner of the 2024 presidential election.
The result of the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election was widely condemned as fraudulent by international observers and the Venezuelan opposition.
